Executive Summary of CRADA Work: NLR shall develop a model of an electric thermal energy storage (ETES) system in the System Advisor Model (SAM) framework that uses a salt and particle slurry developed by PowderMet as the thermal energy storage medium. The ETES shall consist of a recuperated sCO Brayton cycle 2 using 2-tank indirect thermal energy storage and an electric heater for heat input.
